description:
Use this when the user asks what their chart says about one area of life (career, marriage, finance, health, property, children, education, travel, legal and others) and a reproducible verdict with its reasons and sources is wanted. Prefer it to get_forecast when no written narrative is needed.
Deterministic reading of one life area: the verdict, the factors for and against it, timing windows, a cross-check of the verdict, and the classical texts it is grounded in. Every layer is declared as present, computed_empty, not_covered or failed, so nothing is silently missing. No language model is called: the same chart always gets the same reading.
Cost: 5 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"birthData":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209},"domain":"career"}

birthData.description: The person's birth data: date, local time (omit if unknown), IANA timezone, latitude and longitude.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

domain.description: Life area to read, e.g. career, marriage, finance or health.

name: interpret_domain

CorpusResolution.description: How the classical evidence on this chart leans, as counts. Never source names on this surface.

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

coverage.description: Whether each optional block was computed. `computed_empty` means it ran and found nothing; `failed` means it did not run.

verdictContested.description: True when the methods read the opposite way to this response's verdict.

classicalSources.description: Titles of the classical texts the domain is grounded in. Omitted until validated.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.

title: Reading of one life area
